caption: The drawing depicts a pair of ornate, cast iron andirons placed parallel to each other, positioned on a plain, off-white background. Each andiron has three legs, with the front legs featuring decorative curves and scrollwork, and terminating in small rounded feet. The top of each andiron includes a circular handle-like shape with additional decorative flourish. The metal portions are various shades of brown and tan, with areas of lighter and darker hue suggesting wear or shadowing. The andirons are connected at the base with a horizontal metal bar, depicted in a rusty brown tone similar to the main structure. There are no other objects or notable markings in the image, except for a small text in the lower right corner reading "PAUL. POPINBARGER."
title: Andiron or Fire Dog
